title: Reversing a linked list: prev, cur, next

steps.caption: Reverse a linked list by turning every arrow around. prev starts as None, cur at the head.
Save nxt = cur.next (2) first, or the rest of the list is lost.
cur.next = prev: 1 now points to None.
Save nxt = cur.next (3) first, or the rest of the list is lost.
cur.next = prev: 2 now points back to 1.
Save nxt = cur.next (4) first, or the rest of the list is lost.
cur.next = prev: 3 now points back to 2.
Save nxt = cur.next (None) first, or the rest of the list is lost.
cur.next = prev: 4 now points back to 3.
cur is None. prev (4) is the new head. One pass, O(n) time, O(1) space.
